name: Chocolate, Peanut Butter, Banana & Date Oatmeal Protein Bites
ingredients: vanilla whey-based protein powder (containing 20 grams protein/serving)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Peel bananas, break into chunks, and place in a medium bowl. Mash with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
Roughly chop dates. Add to the bowl with the banana along with eggs, peanut butter, and maple syrup. Stir to combine.
Add oats, protein powder, cocoa powder, cinnamon, and salt to the bowl. Stir once more to combine the batter.

Using a ¼-cup measure, scoop batter onto the baking sheets, leaving some space between. Use the back of a spoon to spread each "bite" into a 3-inch circle. Place in the oven and bake until just firm to the touch, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Allow to cool for a few minutes before transferring to plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
